comment: Hand-written, and in a directory of its own so that re-running the agent
cannot overwrite it -- `nativeImageMetadata` writes only to the sibling
META-INF/native-image/** it finds, so the two are merged for it and kept
logback.xml is here because the agent records it as a CLASSPATH resource:
logback asks a ClassLoader for it, and that is what the agent sees. In the
image the showcase runs on the module path, so the file lives at the root of
a named module and has to be registered against that module or it is simply
not there. The symptom is a silent image: with no configuration found,
logback ends up with no appenders and prints nothing at all -- not even its
